description: Hand-labelled retrieval pairs. Each question names the corpus document that MUST appear in the top-k for the answer to be groundable. Deliberately includes the awkward phrasings that failed in Phase 2 -- exact-phrase questions, bare abbreviations, and interrogative framing -- because those are the cases the expansion layer exists to fix.
measured_baseline_note: Phase 2 measured: 'Recovery Time Objective' returned 0 results against the engineering datastore even though backup-restore-procedure contains that exact phrase, while 'recovery objective backup restore' returned it at 0.95.
